scope: Full original KatoUse, KatoTwo and RigII, with published foundations and the literal original modularity antecedent.

findings.topic: Kato critical twist and local conditions
findings.detail: Root inspected original primary PDF pages235 and240. Theorem14.2(1) has1<=r<=k-1, r!=k/2, every finite coefficient place, finite abelian extension, and includes CM. Section14.1 is the exact unramified/Bcris condition. Formula14.10.3 uses inverse arithmetic Frobenius, matching the source. For k=2e+1 and r=e all hypotheses hold and W=V(f)(e).

Finite coefficient descent and equivariant local primitives are the inherited exact ADK/BX/DX comparison. Divisibility of rational Selmer classes plus bounded integral cohomology and finite discrete Selmer image proves zero. Restriction to a finite abelian character field is injective by explicit characteristic-zero averaging. Original KatoUse and KatoTwo antecedents and quantifiers are retained.

findings.topic: Actual local point and rank-two extension
findings.detail: Root read the ordered-product ideal containment, distinct-eigenvalue flag on I intersect ker(tau), normalizer calculation, prime-to-ell inertial character killing and class-number argument. The actual corner has determinant1 and middle1, and the signed formula W(g)=B_g D2^((1-eta(g))/2) gives exactly the original IsExt.

The elementary two-dimensional projective/self-twist lemma covers both distinct and repeated restricted characters. The actual inertia character has infinite cyclotomic part and yields the contradiction kappa(u)^8=1. This proves irreducibility on the full infinite cyclotomic kernel, without assuming equality of its finite part with the original tau.

findings.topic: Actual base change and polarized pairing
findings.detail: Opened primary Langlands base-change text and checked Lemma11.3(b)/Proposition11.4. The exceptional induced case would force eta self-twist, ruled out by irreducibility on G_K. RNC2 adelization, the half-determinant twist, geometric Satake q^(1/2) normalization, multiplier norm character and sign are matched before BLGGT existence. The explicit symmetric J2 pairing agrees up to scalar, giving minus-transpose on all M2.

Verified the corner, two off-diagonal p_t/s_t maps and middle scalar action at H and c. The sections satisfy p_t s_t=2 and their half-sum plus corner/scalar is the identity. Kato, the checked Thorne application and quadratic scalar vanishing give an explicit primitive for every original continuous nine-dimensional Selmer cocycle.

Compared the exact RigII definition including arbitrary original closures, K, ell, coefficient ring, N, e, psi, Dat, ULoc, marked g1, actual IsPt, fixed iota and universal IsExt-to-IsModular antecedent. The proof retains that antecedent and supplies its required actual extension; no independent OneChar or ordinary coefficient automorphy conclusion is inferred.

selected_whole_contract_reviewed.conclusion: Entire original RigII implication; actual extension and all nine polarized adjoint coordinates reconstructed.
